limits: Exhaustive tasks generated from this stored corpus, not independent natural-language questions.
Deterministic URL and record ID lookup; no model generated or graded answers.
The flat URL index uses the exact same stored references and is a strong baseline. It can be reused.
Counts are o200k JSON transport material, not billed usage or latency of model reasoning.
Graph versus direct record material includes different structural fields; no claim of equal answer quality.
Human navigation speed, novel task output quality and independent OSS adoption remain unmeasured.
